log.text: Markets & Groupings becomes the Groups & Odds Desk: Jade leads, Oscar prices, Kofi (value) and Hannah (leg selection) join. Tom and Leah's desks go to them: draw risk stays with Mia and build reliability with Allan, who do that work in the sprint.
Hired Omar as CFB Analyst. CFB has 58 graded games: enough history for a dedicated analyst and a Multi-sport department.
Hired Leah as Reliability Engineer. Only 4/10 recent builds were green: Allan needs a second pair of hands on the pipeline.
Hired Tom as Draw Risk Analyst. 8 of 48 Strong calls were drawn out (17%): draws are our biggest single cause of misses.
Hired Jade as Accumulator Strategist at Douglas's request: three groups of five a day, mixed odds.
Hired Oscar as Odds Analyst at Douglas's request: bookmaker prices on every suggested leg.
Opened a new department: Markets & Groupings.
Hired Priya as England Championship Specialist. England Championship is at 37% over 76 games, the weakest league, and nobody owns it full-time.
